import json
	from exchange.architecturebuilder.files import save_file_to_directory, read_file
	from com.inductiveautomation.ignition.gateway import IgnitionGateway
	context = IgnitionGateway.get()
	projectParentFolder = str(context.systemManager.dataDir.absoluteFile).replace('\\','/')
	directory_path = projectParentFolder + '/savedFiles/customComponents'
	file_name = 'customComponents'
	upload=system.util.jsonDecode(event.file.getString())
	
	saved=save_file_to_directory(file_name, directory_path, upload)
	if saved==True:
		system.perspective.sendMessage("componentAdded", True)
	self.clearUploads()

# implement your handler here
	components=system.util.jsonDecode(system.util.jsonEncode(self.view.custom.fileContents))
	
	fileSave=system.util.jsonEncode(components)
	
	filename='Custom_Components'
	
	filename='{}_{}.json'.format(filename,system.date.format(system.date.now(),"yyyy-MM-dd"))
	system.perspective.download(filename, fileSave)

import json
	from exchange.architecturebuilder.files import save_file_to_directory, read_file
	from com.inductiveautomation.ignition.gateway import IgnitionGateway
	context = IgnitionGateway.get()
	projectParentFolder = str(context.systemManager.dataDir.absoluteFile).replace('\\','/')
	directory_path = projectParentFolder + '/savedFiles/customComponents'
	file_name = 'customComponents'
	
#	data={"customComponents":system.util.jsonDecode(system.util.jsonEncode(self.view.custom.fileContents.customComponents))}
	customs=system.util.jsonDecode(system.util.jsonEncode(self.view.custom.fileContents.customComponents))
	customs.pop(self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexRepeater").custom.selectedIndex)
	self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexRepeater").custom.selectedIndex=-1
	data={"customComponents":customs}
	self.view.custom.fileContents.customComponents=customs
	
	saved=save_file_to_directory(file_name, directory_path, data)
	if saved==True:
		system.perspective.sendMessage("componentAdded", True)
		system.perspective.sendMessage('cancelConfigs',True,scope='session')

messageHandlers.script:
import json
	from exchange.architecturebuilder.files import save_file_to_directory, read_file
	from com.inductiveautomation.ignition.gateway import IgnitionGateway
	context = IgnitionGateway.get()
	projectParentFolder = str(context.systemManager.dataDir.absoluteFile).replace('\\','/')
	directory_path = projectParentFolder + '/savedFiles/customComponents'
	file_name = 'customComponents'
	
	currentData=str(read_file('{}/{}.json'.format(directory_path,file_name)))
	self.view.custom.fileContents=json.loads(currentData)
